name: DevOps
description: On-call and delivery: incidents, what changed, and who owns it.
defaults:
[agents]
visible = ["oncall", "why", "impact", "ownership", "catchup", "changelog", "standup"]

[fleet]
enabled = true

[[fleet.job]]
name = "devops-changelog-nightly"
agent = "changelog"
interval_seconds = 86400
